children: Guidewire Software, Inc. reported full-year 2026 results with revenue of $1.48B, net income of $139.28M and diluted EPS of $1.63, driven by strong cloud subscription growth and continued margin improvements versus the prior year.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per share”.
Annual recurring revenue (ARR) grew 19% to $1,237M, reflecting accelerating adoption of cloud subscriptions.
Revenue mix shifted materially from term licenses to cloud subscriptions, increasing subscription revenue and deferred revenue balances.
Guidewire expanded operational capacity to support cloud growth, with approximately 670 cloud, 1,015 services and 1,412 R&D personnel.
Subscription gross margins improved amid continued investments in cloud infrastructure, AI features and R&D.
Management highlighted strong momentum with systems integrator partners and increased implementations driving migrations and renewals.
